execution_amendment: Two pre-report attempts stopped before report materialization because strict JSON encoding rejected numpy.bool_ gate values. The implementation converted all gate facts to built-in bool and added a complete report serialization regression; source bytes, representations, metrics, thresholds and stop rules were unchanged before the two formal runs.
interpretation: The Portra-versus-Ektar contrast has material magnitude at every exposure, but its direction and component signs are not stable across the four exposure conditions, even after removing each stock/exposure's per-channel patch mean. This explains why the held-exposure Ektar arm in SF3.A3I can prefer the wrong-stock or pooled model. The result requires new independently grouped roll/process/scanner and exposure-controlled observations; it does not justify greater operator capacity on this cohort.
